Work with the Customer Success team on research, analysis, documentation, and other customer-facing initiatives. Take ownership. Manage assigned projects and tasks independently, communicate progress clearly, and look for ways to improve how we work. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR A student or recent graduate in Business, Marketing, Communications, Psychology, HR, Economics, or a related field. Strong curiosity and willingness to learn, with an interest in understanding people, workplaces, and business problems. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns and draw meaningful conclusions from data. Familiarity with analytics or CRM tools is a plus. A structured and detail-oriented approach to work, especially when handling customer data and reports. A customer-first mindset and an interest in understanding and solving customer problems. Comfortable experimenting with AI tools and new ways of working. Prior experience with AI tools is a plus, but curiosity and willingness to learn matter more. Someone who takes ownership, follows through on tasks, and is comfortable working independently. You will also get the opportunity to experiment with AI-first ways of working and learn how modern AI tools can be used to improve research, analysis, reporting, and customer deliverables. If you perform well and demonstrate strong ownership, there is an opportunity to convert to a full-time role at CultureMonkey. THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET Someone who is curious, proactive, analytical, and genuinely interested in understanding people and businesses. Someone who doesn't just complete a task but wants to understand why it matters and what can be done better. Someone who can look at a dataset, research a workplace trend, or listen to a customer problem and think, "What can we learn from this?" Someone who is excited to experiment with AI, learn new tools, and find better ways of doing things. Someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, learns quickly, and is excited to work in a fast-moving environment. Someone who wants to build, learn, and make an impact rather than simply complete an internship. If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.
